metadata.description: Kerd: opinionated workflow skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: kerd
plugins.description: Opinionated workflow toolkit: rehearsing work turn by turn into a sketchbook and score then performing it as a concert checked against its goals, risks kept in view in the sketchbook, bounded score composition, per-step delegation and managed Codex context continuation, a Conductor chat that rolls itself into a fresh session in tmux, session discipline, session and machine handoff, knowledge management, project audits, human writing voice, structural health, visual agreement, and native Claude/Codex session collaboration with role and review-cadence continuity, and effort-sized native players dispatched with an explicit model

plugins.name: overtone
plugins.description: Optional companion mod: a usage band above the prompt (context left, 5-hour and weekly allowance left, cache hit, red alerts) and a guard that asks before a private path is staged, committed or pushed toward a public repo
